corrections.text: The article quotes Elastic Search Labs as saying the feature is "currently in technical preview and limited to Enterprise subscriptions on stateful deployments." The source does not contain this sentence; it instead presents the restriction as a bulleted list: "ES|QL Data Federation is in technical preview, for: Enterprise subscriptions only. Stateful deployments only (Elastic Cloud Hosted and Elastic Self-Managed), with Elastic Serverless coming soon. Amazon S3 only." The restriction itself is accurate; the wording was condensed into a sentence and presented as a direct quote.

The article quotes StockTitan as saying Elastic's planned integrations extend to "data lake catalogs, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, and PostgreSQL." The source's actual wording is "data lake catalogs and data warehouses and databases such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, and PostgreSQL." The list of named integrations is accurate; the quoted sentence condenses the source's phrasing.
